prompt: Hero is on the button with KQs and the pot is unopened. Which compact preflop action fits this transfer spot?
why_v1: The pot is unopened, the hand is strong, and the button has position, so this is the clean open-raise frame.
feedback_correct_v1: Correct. Strong hand plus button position in an unopened pot makes raising the clean preflop action.
feedback_incorrect_v1: Incorrect. KQs on the button with no open in front should not drift into call or fold; the clean position-informed action is raise.
